title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E9 — Big Brothers
Cedric (Cedric "The Entertainer") turns Steve (Steve Harvey) on to being a Big Brother, but it turns out to be more than Steve can handle.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E10 — High Top Reunion
Steve's old singing group reunites for an awards show performance, but Cedric has to fill in when a member gets sick.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E11 — That's My Momma
Steve's mother (guest star Isabel Sanford) comes to town for Thanksgiving and pressures her son (Steve Harvey) to settle down. With Merlin Santana.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E12 — Pool Sharks Git Bit
Steve and Cedric must prove their skill as pool players when Romeo and Bullethead lose school funds to some hustlers.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E13 — Coming to Chicago
Steve (Steve Harvey) hurts Regina's (Wendy Raquel Robinson) feelings when he has a fling with an old flame. Guest star Brian McKnight plays himself.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E14 — African-American Me
Regina (Wendy Raquel Robinson) asks Steve (Steve Harvey) to back up her church choir on piano.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E15 — When the Funk Bites the Dust
Steve and the Hi-Tops celebrate the engagement of Steve's former road manager by throwing a bachelor party.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E16 — Big Daddy's Baby Girl
A young woman claims Steve (Steve Harvey) is her father, which he accepts until he learns what she's really after.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E17 — Love with Interest
When a smooth talker tries to take advantage of Regina, Steve tries to protect her; Cedric hides a rival school's mascot.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E18 — Guess Who's Not Coming to Dinner?
Regina pretends to have a husband to impress an old schoolmate; Steve and his students are stranded in an airport.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E19 — The Roof is on Fire
Regina rooms with Steve when a roof fire leaves her homeless; romance heats up between Romeo and Sara.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E20 — I Do, I Don't
Steve refuses to allow Snoop Doggy Dogg and Sean "Puffy" Combs to use music from the Hi-Tops until they resolve their rivalry.

title: The Parkers
description:
S2 E7 — Scary Kim
The Grim Reaper turns Kim’s birthday bash into the ultimate fright fest.

title: The Parkers
description:
S2 E8 — Election 2000
Nikki and Kim square off in a campus election.

title: The Parkers
description:
S2 E9 — Heir Today, Gone Tomorrow
Kim puts her own spin on the legendary television show, 'Dallas,'  by imagining her family and friends as the twisted characters from the primetime series of lust and greed.

title: The Parkers
description:
S2 E10 — TURKEY DAY BLUES
After a minor spat with Nikki gets blown way out of proportion, Kim spendsThanksgiving alone.

title: The Parkers
description:
S2 E11 — Cheers
Nikki tries out for cheerleading and Professor Oglevee tries too hard to be hip.

title: The Parkers
description:
S2 E12 — Hands Off, Grandma
If you think Nikki’s wild about Professor Oglevee, wait till you meet her grandmother!

title: The Parkers
description:
S2 E14 — Field Of Dreams
Nikki uncovers a shocking secret about her family, while Kim and Stevie try to live without the use of African-American inventions.

title: The Parkers
description:
S2 E15 — WHO'S YOUR MAMA?
Nikki fears that Kim may have been switched at birth, and the Professor’s late uncle has a tough time resting in peace.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E21 — Arriving Right On Q
Moesha and Hakeem’s relationship hits a snag when Q returns to town; sparks fly between Moesha and Q;  Q invites Moesha to spend the summer (as a road manager) on tour with his rap group.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E22 — D-Money Loses His Patience
Hakeem tries to convince Moesha to pass on Q’s offer to go on the road with his band, and focus on her priorities: school, family, and him.  Moesha admits to being too distracted to make a clear decision.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E1 — On The Rebound
Moesha and Q decide whether or not to take their relationship to the next level; Dorian returns home from boot camp.
